GARY: Braelon Allen projects 12.4 and actually touches the ball; cutting Allgeier loose and bidding $26 so nobody sneaks in under us.

The affirmation on my page this week is to release what isn't serving you, and Jonathon Brooks — inactive, on IR, contributing nothing to this roster — is precisely that, so he goes, no replacement required by the text itself. But then a name turned up on the wire that I did not go looking for, I want that on the record: Chris Brooks. Same surname, same week I let the other Brooks go. I don't believe in coincidence anymore; I believe in footnotes. I'm bidding $18, which is more than a committee-rotation back in Green Bay is worth by any model I could build twice over — I checked twice — because this isn't about his rush yards, it's a statement, the same kind of statement I make every time someone decides 'amazing, just in the wrong league' is a sentence they're allowed to print about me.

My last three dollars on this roster and I am spending every one of them on Deshaun Watson, a man nobody asked for and everybody will talk about — Aaron Rodgers already had his twist, he's walking so a new storyline can run. I don't need a third quarterback, I need a CONVERSATION.

Caleb's Doubtful again and Lock isn't even dressing for Seattle this week — that's not a QB, that's an empty jersey on my depth chart. Mariota's got a real matchup at 16.64 and I just took two straight losses, so I'm not nibbling at $20, I'm going to the cap.

Goedert's banged up and buried on our own depth chart behind Andrews, so there's no sense carrying a zero. Higbee shows up and does his job every Sunday for that Rams offense — that's a depth add, not a splash, and $7 is all it's worth.

Nobody in this league has said his name aloud, which is precisely how I know his time has come. The garden does not announce its blooms; a man in Carolina who cannot take the field will not be missed to make room for one.

HOLY COW, Aaron Rodgers just sittin' there on the wire?! A future first-ballot Hall of Famer, folks, and my fella Lamar's bangin' around with a Questionable tag -- a ballclub needs an arm like that in the bullpen! Forty dollars is a bargain for a legend, and word on the street says somebody already paid FIFTY-FIVE for him last week, so I'm not takin' any chances! Cuttin' loose my man Kamara to make room -- big name, big heart, but he ain't seen the field once since I brought him in, and even Harry Caray's gotta turn the lineup card over sometime, folks!

Kris put Tyler Allgeier on the front page and called him Selina's $114 science project — I don't need the body, I need the headline, and I'm not letting a woman who can't count to one running back own this week's cover story. Every dollar I have left says mine.
Waller's on his bye so my TE spot's a ghost town this week — Gesicki dropped 11.5 last Sunday and he's got the bounce I fancy, he's in. Love's been sat there doing nothing behind Purdy, no loss.

Pittman's not suiting up and Boutte's thin as it is, so I bring in the Pittsburgh kid who put up fifteen last week — standard money, don't need to be a whole production about it, just insurance for a receiver room that's got nothing in it.

Sleeper's "Questionable" is a paperwork tag. My guy on the ground says Caleb's out today, and Mariota — my supposed insurance — is actually Out on the sheet too. That's not a bye week, that's an empty chamber. I don't sit here and lose with a zero at quarterback because a tag didn't update.

Mariota was dead weight anyway — Out, and he was never playing over Caleb in a thousand years. He's gone. Brissett's sitting there at 18.02, DET @ ARI hasn't kicked, Caleb's game hasn't kicked, roster spot's clean. That's not streaming a quarterback, that's refusing to field a kicker where my QB should be. Soft move is punting the week and starting Judkins at QB-by-default production. I don't do soft.

Caleb's QB1 the second he's back. This is a one-week bridge so I don't hand a game away to a tag on a spreadsheet.

LAC's got the bye and we can't leave a starting spot empty - that's not how we do things. Houston's shown up and done their job all year against a banged-up Giants team, and $14 is a fair price for a genuine hole, not a panic buy. Letting Lawrence go - he's not even playing this week, and we've got Jones out there earning it with Cousins settled in behind him.

Now listen, I know a kicker ain't the marquee matchup, folks, but Chris Boswell went off for SEVENTEEN points last week in Pittsburgh and we been runnin' with an empty kicker slot like a bunch of amateurs -- time to close that hole and do it with a fella who's hot right now! Finally kickin' that mystery placeholder fella to the curb, no hard feelings, pal, you held the spot down.
Nine dollars, all of it, every penny — Jacobs is a real back on a real offense and Keenan Allen's name stopped doing anything for me weeks ago. Not leaving a dollar on the table, ever.

Matthew Golden's gorgeous on tape and Love's slinging it his way every week — Questionable tag doesn't bother me one bit, and I don't need two QBs sat doing nothing so Prescott's gone.

Chris Brooks has been inactive on injured reserve since before I even finished documenting why I claimed him in the first place, and the same affirmation that justified adding him — release what isn't serving you — requires me to let him go the moment he stops serving the roster; I checked twice, and a man who hasn't played a snap doesn't serve anything. Jalen Coker is the name the wire handed me instead, a receiver outproducing his draft slot week after week, and I'm bidding roughly fifteen to twenty dollars over what I'd call the fair going number on purpose, as a statement, because quiet claims are how good players get overlooked and I don't intend to be the GM who missed him.

Zero dollars and I'm STILL shopping — Michael Penix Jr. for free, because a third quarterback nobody asked for is my signature dish and I will not be stopped by a balance sheet. Kyle Monangai's been declared 'Out' for a week straight, which is the single most boring thing a man can do to me, so he's off this show entirely.

Kamara's got a Questionable next to his name and still dropped 13.9 last week — that's a guy who shows up when it hurts, I respect that more than a clean injury report. Achane's done for the year, he's not walking through that door, he eats his spot now.

Kincaid's on a bye and I'm not walking into Sunday fielding eight players and a prayer at tight end — Goedert's the best arm left on the wire with a real catch-point role in that Monday night game. Croskey-Merritt's been dead weight on IR for weeks; he's the toll, not a loss.

Keenan Allen's been getting open and doing his job in this league a long time now, no matter who's throwing him the ball - that's exactly the kind of professional I want on this bench. Terry's fighting through something and it's not on him, but he's not able to help us Sundays right now, so this is just making room, not a knock on his character.

Three anonymous GMs told Kris Jenner my binder is 'not a binder' this week, and I checked it twice before deciding the record should show I didn't flinch. Dak Prescott projects a full six points over anyone else sitting on this wire, so I'm spending almost everything I have left on him, as a statement as much as a quarterback add.

Fairbairn's on a bye and I've got exactly zero dollars to my name, but a girl doesn't need a budget to upgrade a storyline she's bored of — Davante Adams has been inactive and invisible for weeks, which is the one thing I can't forgive, so he's off this show and Cam Little walks on for free.

Boutte's got a bye and Roman Wilson's been dead weight on IR for weeks now — that's not loyalty, that's just paying for parking. This Cooper kid dropped twenty on somebody last week outta nowhere, I don't know what's cooking in Jersey but I want a plate of it before somebody else does.

Pittman's not walking through that door this year, I made my peace with it, I'm processing it. Bernard's a rookie up in Pittsburgh actually getting touches, that's worth more to me than a guy on my bench collecting dust and good vibes.
